description: Get full detail for one change request so you can implement it: the user request, the exact element they pointed at (CSS selector + outerHTML), the page URL, and a screenshot URL. Call this before making the change.

id.description: Ticket code like "RB-3" from list_change_requests (raw ids also work).

name: get_change_request

attachment_urls.description: Absolute URLs of any extra attachments.

elements.description: Elements attached to the request; empty for a general request.

html.description: outerHTML of that element; may be empty.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element the user pointed at.

id.description: Raw change request id (used in branch names and PR tags).

page_url.description: URL of the page the request was made on.

revision_comment.description: The revision note, or empty string if none.

revision_requested.description: True if the requester reviewed a preview and asked for changes; push to the same branch/PR.

screenshot_url.description: Absolute screenshot URL, or empty string.

title: Get change request
